		<div class="entry-meta">
			<span class="entry-date"><a href="https://youthexpat.com/2024/04/29/the-eira-francis-davies-scholarship-at-swansea-university/" rel="bookmark"><time class="entry-date" datetime="2024-04-29T07:06:53+02:00">April 29, 2024</time></a></span> <span class="byline"><span class="author vcard"><a class="url fn n" href="https://youthexpat.com/author/chydaisy1/" rel="author">chydaisy1</a></span></span>			<span class="comments-link"><a href="https://youthexpat.com/2024/04/29/the-eira-francis-davies-scholarship-at-swansea-university/#respond">Leave a comment</a></span>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong><em>Application Deadline: 11:59pm (BST) Sunday 26th May 2024</em></strong></p>



<div style="height:25px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>LOCATION: </strong>United Kingdom</p>



<div style="height:25px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<p class="has-text-align-justify wp-block-paragraph">The Eira Francis Davies Scholarship is a full tuition fee scholarship ordinarily awarded to one outstanding female student per academic year. The student must be a national of and resident in an eligible developing country, who pursues a postgraduate taught Master’s programme within the Faculty of Medicine, Health and Life Science.</p>



<div style="height:25px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<div class="wp-block-group is-vertical is-layout-flex wp-container-core-group-is-layout-4fc3f8e1 wp-block-group-is-layout-flex">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>ELIGIBILITY:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Applicants must fulfil the following eligibility criteria:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">hold a minimum 2:1 Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">have formally received an offer to study one of the following full-time, postgraduate taught Master’s programmes at Swansea University for entry September 2024:</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/biomedical-science-clinical-biochemistry-msc-pgdip/">Biomedical Science (Clinical Biochemistry), MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/biomedical-science-clinical-microbiology-msc-pgdip/">Biomedical Science (Clinical Microbiology), MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/psychology/clinical-psychology-and-mental-health-msc/">Clinical Psychology and Mental Health, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/genomic-medicine-msc-pgdip-pgcert/">Genomic Medicine, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/health-social-care/health-care-management-msc/">Healthcare Management, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/health-data-science-msc-pgdip-pgcert/">Health Data Science, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/health-informatics-msc-pgdip-pgcert/">Health Informatics, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/medical-neuroscience-msc/">Medical Neuroscience, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/medical-radiation-physics-msc/">Medical Radiation Physics, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/medicine/nanomedicine-msc-pgdip-pgcert/">Nanomedicine, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/health-social-care/public-health-and-health-promotion-msc-pgdip/">Public Health and Health Promotion, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/psychology/research-methods-in-psychology-msc/">Research Methods in Psychology, MSc</a></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">be female.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">be a new student to Swansea University from September 2024.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">within their application, demonstrate strong academic ability, financial plan to study and motivation for their chosen course at Swansea University.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">be a national, and permanent resident of an <a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/media/Eligible-Countries-2024.docx">Eira Francis Davies Eligible Countries 2024</a> as listed by the World Bank Country and Lending Groups classification as being ‘low income’ or ‘lower-middle income’ as of 1 July 2023.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">not receive any other financial support from Swansea University (e.g. tuition fee reduction, scholarship or bursary).</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">not be a progressing student from <a href="https://www.swansea.ac.uk/the-college/">The College</a>, Swansea University.</p>
</div>



<div style="height:25px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<div class="wp-block-group is-vertical is-layout-flex wp-container-core-group-is-layout-4fc3f8e1 wp-block-group-is-layout-flex">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>BENEFIT:</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Eira Francis Davies Scholarship is a full tuition fee scholarship</p>
